later_separate_pair_work: This driver does not calculate or admit half/backend/effect gates. Separate original all257sample5Pa pressureRMS/.005mm materialXYZ displacement limits, applicable independent half normalizedp/v/u<=1e-4, variable ON-OFF effect>max(.001Pa,10*actual variable-half pressure), and backend comparisons remain required. failure_policy: No overwrite. A completed solve with reader/wrapper failure is kept and only a new offline analysis revision may repair it; never relaunch a finished solver. Failed prior source/component/wrapper evidence stays intact. No relaxed thresholds, automatic admission or old-worker restart.
